gen-fs-oswald-gf-headland-one: Oswald is confident and strong, its tightly knit rows of text pressing together like a display heading should. Headland One, by contrast, gives its dignified serif letters well-spaced room.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Confident and strong, Oswald is a display heading in tightly knit rows. Hedvig Letters Serif brings open-ended curves and a tall, sturdy lowercase, and that sturdiness is the pair's real strength.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-lisu-bosa: Oswald brings confident, strong lines in tightly knit rows, a display heading with a firm hand. Lisu Bosa then spills its tall, sturdy lowercase into open space below.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-marcellus-sc: Oswald is confident and strong, setting tightly knit rows of text in a display heading that means business. Marcellus SC reads gently, dignified and literary, page after page.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-montagu-slab: Tight, confident, and strong: Oswald stacks its display rows with no slack. Montagu Slab has robust downstrokes and slender turns, a refined, traditional texture that stays comfortable line after line.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-poltawski-nowy: Confident and strong, Oswald sets tightly knit rows of text in a display heading that holds its ground. Poltawski Nowy stays plain, traditional and literary, content to let the heading lead.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-slabo-27px: Tight rows and a strong voice up top. Oswald is confident and strong in display, while Slabo 27px keeps a tight set width and curves with plenty of daylight inside.
gen-fs-panchang-lora: Confident and expressive, Panchang draws wire-like strokes with open stretches of blank between each stem and curve. Lora, bookish and literary, adds a mild weight shift that makes lingering easy.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-faustina: Faustina brings classic authority, thinning its bowls gently beneath the tight, friendly lines of Pramukh Rounded. Faustina reads steadily, its open-jawed c keeping the text moving down the page.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-hedvig-letters: Friendly and rounded, Pramukh Rounded bunches its glyphs tight with large lowercase forms. Hedvig Letters Serif then reads with authority, its open-ended curves and sturdy lowercase carrying the text along.
